correct.evidence: Every SPEC input and every earlier finding's input (S1, O1, S2, D4, C, the w3 end table, the hours table, the M16 and M18 inputs, the future card, card end 9999-12-31) gives the right date, worked by hand: opt.last_day 2026-09-16 to 2026-10-25, prepare 2026-08-16, stem.last_day opens 2027-03-02, reports 2026-07-11 and 2026-08-13, evaluation 2026-08-12, limit days 2026-08-29, 2026-09-29, 2027-01-12.

sourced.evidence: No rule, number or quote changed since the third review; sources verify finds every quote in its snapshot; each day count used is in its saved quote; the job-start report stays marked a reading.

never_assumes.evidence: The third review's four blocking classes are fixed by the class (exists witness, counter groups, unreadable present, unknown hours). A negative hours figure is still read as fact and gives an at-or-over line with nothing asked (finding 1).

inside_the_boundary.evidence: Labels name the step and say a planning date; the limit day carries no words about what follows. The planning setting's working shows a generic name with no not-law mark (note 1).

secure.evidence: No input crashed or stalled: 2026-13-40, 08/03/2026, 9999-12-31, hours True, 1e9 and forty, dangling links; a wrong id prefix is refused with CaseStructureError.

tested.evidence: Ten mutants, all caught with a passing baseline: M5, M7, M9, M15, M16, M18, M20, H1, H2 and E1 (the old code of the third review's findings 1 and 4). No test enters a negative number (finding 1).

findings.title: A negative hours figure is read as a real one and gives an at-or-over unemployment line
findings.input: masters p1 ending 2026-05-15, OPT a1 2026-06-01 to 2027-05-31, w1 under a1 from 2026-07-01 with employer e1 and hours_per_week -5; today 2026-09-29
findings.what_happens: unemployment.opt_card.a1 is 121, its limit day 2026-08-29, and unemployment.opt_card.at_or_over_limit.a1 is raised; nothing asks about w1's hours (with 40 the count is 30). as_number takes any finite number; a minimum of 0 on the field or a negative read as unreadable would ask it, as 'forty' is asked.

findings.title: The planning setting shows under a generic name in the working
findings.what_happens: SETTING_NAMES names two product settings but not plan.prepare_months, so the working falls back to plain(id). The label 'a planning date' and planning true carry the mark.

findings.title: An empty hours figure becomes 0 in the facts a drafted DSO question may state
findings.input: a work record with start and no hours_per_week
findings.what_happens: sentFacts gives hours_per_week 0. Predates W2-P1 (78b7d69) and is outside its diff; flagged for the web lane.
